description: This file contains unit tests for the AccessTokenRepository class in the OAuth module of the OrangeHRM project. It tests functionalities such as token creation, persistence, revocation, and validation within the OAuth authentication process.

classes.name: AccessTokenRepositoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the access token management functionalities such as creation, persistence, revocation, and validation in the OAuth repository module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, loads fixture data, and prepares the AccessTokenRepository instance with encryption key.

methods.name: testGetNewToken
methods.description: Verifies the creation of a new access token object with correct attributes when provided with a client entity and user identifier.

methods.name: testGetNewTokenWithScopes
methods.description: Checks token creation when specific OAuth scopes are attached, ensuring scopes are correctly serialized.

methods.name: testGetNewTokenAndCallGetExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Tests that calling getExpiryDateTime() on a newly created token triggers the expected error if the property is uninitialized.

methods.name: testGetNewTokenAndCallGetIdentifier
methods.description: Tests that calling getIdentifier() on a newly created token triggers the expected error if the property is uninitialized.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Tests persisting a new access token to the database and verifies the stored data matches the token attributes.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessTokenWithExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Checks that attempting to persist a token with a duplicate identifier raises a violation exception.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessToken
methods.description: Tests revoking a valid access token and verifies its revoked status is updated in the database.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessTokenWhichAlreadyRevoked
methods.description: Ensures revoking an already revoked token does not alter its state.

methods.name: testRevokeNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Verifies that revoking a non-existent token fails silently without error.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks whether the system correctly identifies revoked and active tokens.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevokedForNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Verifies that a non-existing token is treated as not revoked.

methods.name: testGetAccessToken
methods.description: Tests retrieving access tokens by their token string and handling of invalid tokens.
